title: Template compiled from input (ruby) — review required
description: A ruby template engine compiles a template built from parts: ERB.news*([^)]*(?:+|#{). Template syntax in the input executes with the application's authority. This lexical rule flags the compilation; the reviewer confirms the template is fixed or sandboxed.
remediation: Compile fixed templates only and pass input as variables (fixed templates with result(binding)); never build template source from input.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any assembled template matches, including trusted ones.
